newsitem.title: GERMANY: Firm dollar slows Bremen cotton trade.
newsitem.headline: Firm dollar slows Bremen cotton trade.

text.p: Steady dollar levels versus the mark discouraged European yarn spinners' purchases in the Bremen cotton market, a fortnightly report from the local Cotton Exchange said.
But the industry bought medium and low quality from West Africa and Central Asia for shipment up to first quarter 1998.
Spot trades included Syrian medium grades for August.
Upland trades included Tanzanian cotton for September, Peru-Tanguis for Oct/Nov and Greek high grades for fourth quarter 1997/first quarter 1998.
Cotton stocks as of July 18 totalled 49,061 bales compared with 46,173 bales a fortnight earlier and down from 99,552 bales a year earlier.
